description: Land Aquisition - Kiriwaththuduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Gorakawela, Pitabeddara D/S Division, Matara District - Nuwaragala, Elahera D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha), this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers for land acquisition, not for government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters, making it a Land Gazette.
